operations.title: Optimize Orbit tasks for AI agents
operations.body: Make Orbit tasks cheaper and safer for AI agents to claim, load, execute and hand off. Eight SubTasks, from a structured task contract through git-aware completion.

operations.title: Renew lease implicitly on mutating commands
operations.body:
Goal: agents never lose a claim because they forgot `heartbeat`.

Scope: checkpoint, comment add and update by the claim holder renew the lease. JSON output of claim/show/ready includes `lease_remaining_seconds`. Errors carry an optional `error.hint` with the suggested next command; error codes are documented and enumerable.

Non-goals: a background daemon; `orbit run` wrapper (optional follow-up).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] checkpoint by the holder extends lease_until
- [ ] comment add by the holder extends lease_until; by others does not
- [ ] show/claim/ready --json include lease_remaining_seconds for claimed tasks
- [ ] LOCKED, claim-conflict and stale-claim errors include error.hint
- [ ] docs/commands.md lists all error codes
operations.verification: cargo test; manual: claim, wait, checkpoint, confirm lease_until moved

operations.title: Structured acceptance criteria and non-goals fields
operations.body:
Goal: the agent contract is parseable data, not a comment.

Scope: add `acceptance` (list of {id, text, check?}) and `non_goals` to the Task front matter, settable via add/update/batch and shown in `show --json` and export (bump schema_version). `done` accepts `--verified <ids>` and records them; `--run-verification` runs the task `verification` command when it is one.

Non-goals: writing briefs automatically.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] add/update/batch accept acceptance and non_goals with validation limits
- [ ] show --json and export expose them; schema_version bumped and documented
- [ ] done --verified records ids; unknown ids are rejected
- [ ] docs/agents/agent-brief.md updated to describe the fields
operations.verification: cargo test; orbit add with acceptance, then show --json

operations.title: One-call work packet: --context on ready --claim and claim
operations.body:
Goal: claim and load context in a single round trip.

Scope: `--context` adds to the claim result the full task and brief, last checkpoint, recent comments, parent summary, dependency titles with their done-comments, and the worktree path. `--max-tokens N` truncates with explicit truncation markers.

Non-goals: changing default claim output.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] ready --claim --context --json returns the packet in data.context
- [ ] claim --context works for a specific id
- [ ] --max-tokens truncates oldest comments first and sets truncated: true
- [ ] default output is unchanged
operations.verification: cargo test; compare packet against show + comment list + tree

operations.title: Compact output, --fields, TTY-aware JSON default and schema command
operations.body:
Goal: agents pay only for the fields they use and can validate what they parse.

Scope: `--fields a,b` on list/ready/show; default to JSON envelope when stdout is not a TTY; `orbit schema [command]` prints the JSON schema of each command's data.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] --fields limits data keys and rejects unknown names with INVALID_ARGUMENT
- [ ] piped output is JSON without --json; TTY output is unchanged
- [ ] orbit schema ready prints a valid JSON schema matching real output (tested)

operations.title: Append-only checkpoint history with files_touched and commit
operations.body:
Goal: a successor sees the full handoff trail, not only the latest note.

Scope: keep prior checkpoints; `orbit checkpoint list <id>`; optional `--files`; when run in a task worktree, auto-fill files_touched (git diff --stat) and commit (HEAD). Latest checkpoint stays the one in show/ready.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] checkpoint no longer discards earlier entries
- [ ] checkpoint list returns entries oldest first in --json
- [ ] in a worktree, files_touched and commit are auto-filled
- [ ] export and show remain backward compatible (latest checkpoint field unchanged)
operations.verification: cargo test; two checkpoints then checkpoint list

operations.title: Readiness lint and ready --require-brief
operations.body:
Goal: agents do not start from vague tickets.

Scope: `orbit doctor` and `prime` flag ready tasks with an empty body, no acceptance, or no verification; add optional `size` (S/M/L) and flag L as too large; `ready --require-brief` skips tasks failing the lint.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] doctor reports each failing check by task id and code
- [ ] ready --require-brief excludes failing tasks, including with --claim
- [ ] size accepted by add/update; L tasks reported by prime
- [ ] default ready behavior is unchanged

operations.title: Area-aware ready for parallel agents
operations.body:
Goal: parallel agents do not collide on the same area.

Scope: `ready --area <a>` and `--avoid-area <a>` (repeatable); `ready --json` and `prime` show areas currently held by live claims.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] --area and --avoid-area filter, combine with AND, and apply to --claim
- [ ] prime lists areas held by live claims
- [ ] doc example for an orchestrator partitioning work
operations.verification: cargo test; two claims in different areas

operations.title: Git-aware done: verify branch, record commit, draft comment from checkpoints
operations.body:
Goal: closing a task is tied to real work in git.

Scope: `done` in a ticket worktree checks ticket/<id> has commits and the worktree is clean (warn by default, `--strict` to fail); records head commit SHA on the task; `--comment-from-checkpoints` drafts the note from checkpoint history.

Non-goals: auto-merging.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] dirty worktree warns, fails with --strict
- [ ] done records commit in show --json
- [ ] --comment-from-checkpoints composes the comment; explicit --comment wins
- [ ] behavior outside worktrees is unchanged
operations.verification: cargo test; integration test with a temp repo
